headlines.description: — Petey Halpin and Rhys Hoskins each went deep twice and the Cleveland Guardians matched a franchise record for a home game by...
headlines.shortLinkText: Halpin and Hoskins hit 2 homers each and Guardians hit 7 longballs in 13-4 win over Twins

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Trea Turner hit two homers, including the 200th of his career, and drove in five runs, Bryce Harper and Brandon Marsh also went deep and the Philadelphia Phillies beat the Los Angeles Dodgers 10-7 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trea Turner makes up for fielding woes with 2 HRs, 5 RBIs to lead Phillies past Dodgers

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Jazz Chisholm Jr. homered in consecutive at-bats against All-Star Braxton Ashcraft and drove in five runs, powering the New York Yankees to an 8-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jazz Chisholm Jr. homers twice and drives in 5 as Yankees sink Pirates 8-5 after benches clear

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Cedric Mullins, Victor Mesa Jr. and Nick Fortes hit solo homers, Nick Martinez pitched six innings of one-run ball and the AL East-leading Tampa Bay Rays beat the struggling Toronto Blue Jays 7-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays hit 3 solo homers, Nick Martinez pitches 6 innings for win as Rays beat Blue Jays 7-1

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Caleb Durbin hit a tiebreaking homer over the Green Monster with two outs in the eighth inning, and the Boston Red Sox extended the second-longest winning streak in club history to 14 games,...
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox extend win streak to 14, beating Orioles 6-5 to end Baltimore's 7-game streak

events.name: San Diego Padres at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Bryce Elder pitched six strong innings, providing needed rest for an overworked bullpen and leading the Atlanta Braves to a 3-2 victory over the San Diego Padres on Monday night in the opener of a four-game home series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elder goes 6 innings to give Braves' bullpen a rest, Harris and Albies homer in 3-2 win over Padres

events.name: New York Mets at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Cooper Pratt hit his first major league homer and had his first career three-hit game to help spoil Freddy Peralta’s return to Milwaukee as the Brewers defeated the New York Mets 8-3 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Pratt hits 1st career homer as Brewers beat Mets 8-3 in Peralta's return to Milwaukee

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Nick Loftin's squeeze bunt with one out in the ninth inning scored Josh Rojas to give the Kansas City Royals a 4-3 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Loftin's squeeze bunt in the ninth gives the Royals a 4-3 victory over the Giants

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Andrew Benintendi hit a go-ahead three-run double that chased Texas starter Jacob deGrom in the fifth inning and the Chicago White Sox beat the Rangers 10-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Benintendi's 3-run double chases deGrom, helps White Sox to 10-3 win over Rangers

headlines.description: — Spencer Torkelson hit a two-run single in Detroit's three-run 10th inning, and the Tigers topped the Chicago Cubs for a wild 8-6 victory on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torkelson and Dingler help the Tigers beat the Cubs 8-6 in 10 innings

headlines.description: — Jeremy Peña hit a grand slam, Yordan Alvarez homered twice and the Houston Astros snapped a four-game losing streak with an 8-5 win over the Miami Marlins on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peña’s grand slam, Alvarez’s 2 homers power Astros to 8-5 win over Marlins

headlines.description: — Andrés Chaparro, Jacob Young and CJ Abrams homered to lead the Washington Nationals past the Colorado Rockies 7-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chapparo, Young and Abrams homer in Nationals' 7-3 win over Rockies

headlines.description: — Jeff McNeil drove in the go-ahead runs with a pinch-hit single in the seventh inning and the Athletics beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeff McNeil's pinch-hit single in the 7th inning sends the A's to a 5-2 win over the Diamondbacks

headlines.description: — Cal Raleigh hit his sixth career grand slam, George Kirby and three relievers combined for a three-hitter and the Seattle Mariners beat the Cincinnati Reds 8-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raleigh hits 6th career grand slam and Kirby tosses 6 strong innings as Mariners blank Reds 8-0

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Vaughn Grissom drove in the tying run with a one-out double in the ninth inning and Jo Adell was hit by a pitch with the bases loaded to give the Los Angeles Angels a 3-2 comeback win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grissom's clutch hit and Adell's bases-loaded HBP lift Angels to 3-2 walk-off win over Cardinals
